_doc: PI-12 complexity scoring (deck 'PI-12 Estimation - Time to Complexity' v3.9, slide 3; manifest ESTIMATION-ALIGNMENT-MANIFEST.md). Rate Complexity / Amount of Work / Risk Low-Medium-High, add the points, read story points from the band table. Familiarity (first time for the team) is rated under Risk only. Bands changed 2026-10-18 (Bradley): the total goes to the closest story point value on 1/2/3/5/8/13; a tie (4) goes up. Never rounds down.
